notes: Thai month names do not change form inside a date, so monthsInDate equals months. The week starts on SUNDAY. The critical fact for a date implementation: Thailand counts years in the Buddhist Era (พุทธศักราช, พ.ศ.), which runs 543 years ahead of the Common Era — 2026 CE is พ.ศ. 2569 — and a Thai-facing date normally prints the BE year. This pack does NOT convert: the year a config supplies is emitted as given, so a caller that wants พ.ศ. must add 543 itself. Thai also has its own digits ๐๑๒๓๔๕๖๗๘๙, which are still used on official documents and temple signage alongside the Arabic ones.
